scope: Owner decisions on the standalone prayers and five Mass propers: 10 English translation fields in 9 texts and 6 Polish translation fields in 5 texts, captions, word explanations, the Te Deum and Regina caeli citations, the Loreto about sheets, one title and four provenance origins

changes.before: The Litany of Loreto as Poland prays it: the Roman text with one invocation of its own. To the text attested by the 1952 Enchiridion Indulgentiarum the Holy See added Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) and, in 2020, Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium, and beside them Poland says Regína Polóniæ, approved for it in 1920. Mater misericórdiæ had already been granted to Poland in 2014, and the letter of 2020 moved it to the place it holds here, after Mater Ecclésiæ.
changes.after: The Litany of Loreto as Poland prays it: the Roman text with one invocation of its own. In 1962 the Roman text ended with Regína pacis, and in Poland Regína Polóniæ followed it. To the text attested by the 1952 Enchiridion Indulgentiarum the Holy See added Mater Ecclésiæ (1980), Regína famíliæ (1995) and, in 2020, Mater misericórdiæ, Mater spei and Solácium migrántium, and beside them Poland says Regína Polóniæ, approved for it in 1920. Mater misericórdiæ had already been granted to Poland in 2014, and the letter of 2020 moved it to the place it holds here, after Mater Ecclésiæ.

changes.before: Christ’s intention to assume human nature looks ahead from the moment described by horruísti.
changes.after: Christ’s intention to assume human nature looks ahead from the moment described by horruísti. The received English compresses this to taking it upon Himself to deliver man, a wording in use since the sixteenth-century Primer.

changes.after: Czasownik mówi o mocy, nie o dokonanym fakcie: jedna kropla tej Krwi jest w stanie zbawić cały świat od wszelkiej nieprawości. Wers daje sens ogólny („grzechu”), a podpis sens dosłowny.
